main-window.description: The bundled main window ships the internal-alpha product surface and may open the bounded Settings window. It retains the reviewed named command set and has no note generation, generic filesystem, shell, process, dialog, or remote-origin permission.

preview-window.description: The separately identified Preview window may exercise the transcript-alpha commands, content-free voice-profile status, the guided enrolment surface (sitting recorder, measured operating-point review, and profile build/publication, encoder-admitted builds only), explicit preserve-first legacy-profile migration, separately confirmed profile reset, retained-meeting Library with its standing retention overview, exact transcript/title search, the reviewed one-meeting audio-deletion boundary, the separately reviewed whole-meeting deletion boundary, the five named folder and meeting-title commands (which write only the operator's own organization record and touch no transcript, note, or audio), and the frozen withheld-turn restoration. It can report and request the two capture permissions for first run through the manifest-verified permission probe, which holds no storage authority and reads no operator content. It has no note generation, generic filesystem, shell, process, dialog, or remote-origin permission.

settings-window.description: The bounded Settings window may read the manifest-verified capture permission status, persist the closed desktop layout preference, run the existing local voice-profile setup lifecycle through its exact named commands, and update only its own native title. It cannot request general permission and has no meeting, meeting-storage, generic filesystem, shell, process, dialog, or remote-origin authority.
